ownership_rule: Every cross-boundary property has exactly one owner; host-private properties remain behind the adapter.

mismatches.resolution: Keep private width behind the adapter.
Never expose or align private host residual coordinates.
Round-trip canonical strict UTF-8 through the native tokenizer.
Keep vocabulary IDs private; canonical anchors are UTF-8 bytes.
Do not treat embedding coordinates as ABI semantics.
The host realizes authoritative UTF-8 and proves exact round-trip.
Map canonical sequence positions to private host positions.
Keep RMSNorm/LayerNorm private; canonical vectors declare normalization.
Use typed context, span, anchor, and opaque-state channels.
Declare exact fields, float32 channels, and tolerances.
Fusion consumes canonical output intent, not private residual state.
Preserve package-private routing while the host selects capability identity.
Keep V1 private fields inside their authenticated runtime class.

architecture_decision: Use observable canonical state and a host-neutral runtime boundary; reject residual projection and tensor transplantation.
